name: Island View House

tagline.en: In the heart of Roundstone, with views across the bay from the front of the house, and tea and scones when you arrive.
tagline.ga: I gcroílár Chloch na Rón, le radharc trasna an chuain ó thosach an tí, agus tae agus scónaí nuair a shroicheann tú.

mapQuery: Island View House, Roundstone, Co. Galway

en: Island View House sits right in the heart of Roundstone village, with lovely views over the bay and islands from the front rooms.
Guests tell us they love the warm welcome, the tea and scones on arrival, and the chats about where to go next. The harbour, pubs and restaurants are on the doorstep.
ga: Tá Island View House i gcroílár shráidbhaile Chloch na Rón, le radharc álainn ar an gcuan agus ar na hoileáin ó na seomraí tosaigh.

Deir aíonna linn gur breá leo an fháilte chroíúil, an tae agus na scónaí ar theacht dóibh, agus na comhráite faoi cá rachaidh siad ina dhiaidh sin. Tá an cuan, na tithe tábhairne agus na bialanna ag an doras.
